xuanhub.settings.调整状态栏主题、尺寸和停靠方式: Customize the bar theme, size, and docking
xuanhub.settings.选择主题包和明暗模式；保存后立即热重载: Choose a theme pack and color mode; changes reload immediately after saving
xuanhub.settings.决定色板与整体视觉风格: Controls the palette and overall visual style
xuanhub.settings.浅色和深色模式均可跟随主题包: Light and dark modes both use the selected theme pack
xuanhub.settings.尺寸、停靠边缘与系统集成方式: Size, docking edge, and Windows integration
xuanhub.settings.选择显示在屏幕顶部或底部: Show the bar at the top or bottom of the screen
xuanhub.settings.appbar 占用工作区；taskbar 嵌入任务栏: AppBar reserves workspace; Taskbar embeds into the Windows taskbar
xuanhub.settings.最低 20%，避免状态栏不可见: Minimum 20% so the bar remains visible
xuanhub.settings.在左侧选择一个插件: Select a plugin on the left
xuanhub.settings.显示插件当前健康状态和最近一次运行错误: Shows the plugin health and most recent runtime error
xuanhub.settings.查看插件声明、实际授权和运行隔离级别: Review declarations, grants, and isolation level
xuanhub.settings.Python 后端运行在独立进程中，HostServices 请求按声明权限强制: The Python backend runs in a separate process, and HostServices requests enforce declared permissions.
xuanhub.settings.原生插件与宿主在同一进程运行，权限仅作说明，不能限制其直接访问系统资源。: Native plugins run in the host process. Permissions are informational and cannot restrict direct system access.
xuanhub.settings.检测到插件配置版本 %1，可迁移到版本 %2。迁移只修改当前草稿，点击保存后才会: Plugin configuration version %1 can be migrated to version %2. The migration only changes the current draft and is written atomically after you save.
xuanhub.settings.插件配置迁移失败，当前插件已停用；旧配置保持不变。: Plugin configuration migration failed. The plugin is disabled and the previous configuration remains unchanged.
xuanhub.settings.控制插件在状态栏中的位置、显示顺序与占用宽度: Control the plugin position, order, and width on the bar
xuanhub.settings.显示在状态栏的哪一栏: Choose which bar region contains this plugin
xuanhub.settings.仅在当前区域内调整: Moves only within the current region
xuanhub.settings.先收缩，仍放不下时移入更多插件: Shrink first, then move to More plugins if it still does not fit
xuanhub.settings.先收缩，仍放不下时自动隐藏: Shrink first, then hide automatically if it still does not fit
xuanhub.settings.收缩到插件允许的最小宽度后保持显示: Shrink to the plugin minimum, then keep it visible
xuanhub.settings.当前手动宽度会覆盖此响应式策略: The current manual width overrides this responsive policy
xuanhub.settings.使用自适应宽度时由插件策略自动处理: Automatic width follows the plugin's responsive policy
xuanhub.settings.设置页加载失败（详见 xuanhub.log）: Failed to load the settings page (see xuanhub.log)
xuanhub.settings.留空跟随默认: Leave empty to use the default
xuanhub.settings.管理界面语言与 Windows 启动方式: Manage the interface language and Windows startup
xuanhub.settings.默认跟随 Windows，也可以固定使用中文或英文: Follow Windows by default, or always use Chinese or English
xuanhub.settings.保存后立即更新所有已打开界面: All open interfaces update immediately after saving
xuanhub.settings.登录 Windows 后自动启动玄枢状态栏: Start the XuanHub bar automatically after signing in to Windows
xuanhub.settings.通过当前用户的 Windows 启动项运行: Runs from the current user's Windows startup entry
xuanhub.settings.存在未修正的非法输入（红框项），修正后才能保存: Some highlighted fields are invalid. Fix them before saving.
xuanhub.settings.将从插件自带的 %1 个 wheel 安装 %2，并创建仅供该插件使用的私有环境: Install %2 from %1 bundled wheel(s) into a private environment used only by this plugin. The installer will not access the network.
xuanhub.settings.只有在你信任该插件及其 wheel 文件时才继续。: Continue only if you trust this plugin and its wheel files.
xuanhub.settings.未签名包：无法确认发布者身份。原生插件与宿主同进程运行，请只安装可信来源的包。: Unsigned package: the publisher identity cannot be verified. Native plugins run in the host process, so install packages only from sources you trust.
xuanhub.settings.签名证明内容由该密钥签发，但不代表玄枢已经信任此发布者。请核对来源和密钥标识。: The signature proves that this key signed the content; it does not mean XuanHub trusts the publisher. Verify the source and key ID.
xuanhub.settings.将 %1 从 v%2 切换回 v%3。运行中的插件会安全停止并重新加载。: Switch %1 from v%2 back to v%3. A running plugin will be stopped safely and reloaded.
xuanhub.settings.将移除 %1 的全部受管版本。若存在同 id 的内置插件，将自动恢复使用内置版本: Remove all managed versions of %1. If a built-in plugin has the same ID, XuanHub will automatically restore it.
xuanhub.settings.插件配置、私有环境和运行数据也会删除，此操作不可撤销。: Plugin configuration, private environments, and runtime data will also be deleted. This cannot be undone.
xuanhub.settings.查看已安装版本并执行安全回滚或卸载: Review installed versions and safely roll back or uninstall
xuanhub.settings.每行一个 HTTPS 或本机 file URL。检查更新只读取索引，不会自动下载: Enter one HTTPS or local file URL per line. Checking only reads indexes; it never downloads or installs plugins automatically.
xuanhub.settings.更新源不是信任根；下载后仍会校验大小、SHA-256、Manifest、兼容性、: An update source is not a trust root. Downloads are still checked for size, SHA-256, manifest, compatibility, permissions, and publisher signature.
xuanhub.settings.选择后才会下载并验证插件包；验证通过后仍需再次确认安装。: A package is downloaded and verified only after you select it. You must confirm installation again after verification.

xuanhub.settings.errors.配置已被外部修改（热重载/手动编辑），请关闭设置窗口重开后再保存: The configuration changed outside this window. Close and reopen Settings before saving.
xuanhub.settings.errors.状态栏高度需在 24–200 之间: The bar height must be between 24 and 200.
xuanhub.settings.errors.停靠边缘仅支持 top / bottom: The docking edge must be top or bottom.
xuanhub.settings.errors.工作模式仅支持 appbar / taskbar: The working mode must be appbar or taskbar.
xuanhub.settings.errors.主题模式仅支持 dark / light: The theme mode must be dark or light.
xuanhub.settings.errors.写入 config.json 失败（权限/磁盘，详见日志）: Could not write config.json. Check permissions, disk space, and the log.
xuanhub.settings.errors.插件依赖安装后仍无法启动: The plugin still could not start after installing its dependencies.
xuanhub.settings.errors.无法启动离线依赖安装: Could not start offline dependency installation.
xuanhub.settings.errors.请先保存或放弃插件设置草稿，再管理插件包: Save or discard the plugin settings draft before managing plugin packages.
xuanhub.settings.errors.下载的插件包与更新索引不一致: The downloaded plugin package does not match the update index.
xuanhub.settings.errors.请先添加至少一个插件更新源: Add at least one plugin update source first.
xuanhub.settings.errors.应为 %1-%2 的整数: Must be an integer from %1 to %2
xuanhub.settings.errors.应为 %1-%2 的数字: Must be a number from %1 to %2
xuanhub.settings.errors.不在可选值内: Not one of the allowed values
xuanhub.settings.errors.插件声明的正则表达式无效: The plugin declares an invalid regular expression
xuanhub.settings.errors.格式不符合要求: The format does not meet the requirements
xuanhub.settings.errors.无法安全保存插件凭据: Unable to save plugin credentials securely
xuanhub.settings.errors.%1：密钥引用与字段路径不匹配: %1: The secret reference does not match the field path
xuanhub.settings.errors.%1：数组 %2 的嵌套密钥需要 itemKey: %1: Array %2 requires itemKey for nested secrets
xuanhub.settings.errors.py_usage_hub：无法安全保存厂商凭据: py_usage_hub: could not securely save provider credentials
xuanhub.settings.errors.py_usage_hub：无法清除已删除厂商的凭据: py_usage_hub: could not remove credentials for a deleted provider

xuanhub.pluginSlot.无法加载插件界面：%1: Could not load the plugin interface: %1
